title: Typography, Labels, Legends, Styles, Themes, Templates, Atlas & Publishing Layout
objective: Implement cartographic labels/path text, legends/keys/scale/coordinate aids, frames/title blocks/navigation, semantic style tokens, map themes/templates, color grading/effects, print/page layouts, export profiles and atlas navigation while PCA/ARI retain generic style-generation/resource governance and canonical owner-domain truth remains separate.

scope.purpose: Provide cartography-specific typography, label, legend, style/theme/template, atlas and publishing-layout authoring over the existing MCS document/editing/art substrate without replacing generic style-generation/resource governance or canonical game/world authority.

scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS documents can deterministically author and inspect cartographic typography, legends, reusable styles/themes/templates and atlas/print/export layouts while generic style/resource governance and canonical World/Scene/game truth remain unchanged.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after MCS-05 exact-tree publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order, so MCS-07 is selected.
MCS-07 consumes the completed MCS-01/MCS-03/MCS-05 authoring foundations and may author cartographic presentation/layout projections only.
PCA-09 and ARI retain generic style-generation/resource identity, rights and provenance governance; MCS-07 supplies cartography-specific style/layout/profile authoring.
Labels, legends, themes, templates, atlas navigation and publishing layouts do not silently create canonical World, Scene, Visibility, Exploration or other owner-domain truth.
MCS-07 is governed-started on branch work/mcs-07-typography-layout; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
MCS-08, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized by this execution.
next_action: Establish causal RED for the bounded MCS-07 public seam, then implement only the required typography/layout/style/atlas behavior and continue through validation, publication and closeout without starting downstream work.
